title: Andhaadhi Rehab Speech therapy - Videos
description:
Andhaadhi Rehab is a Team of young and enthusiastic Speech language pathologists, Occupational therapists and Special Educators who aim to create a difference in the lives of people with Communication and Swallowing disorders. We thrive hard to educate their families and join hands to help them in the rehabilitation process

We do Online Speech therapy and Occupational therapy services for people all across India - for appointments Contact +91 8122100724 
Website - www.andhaadhirehab.in

This Channel is run by Founder of Andhaadhi Rehab - Ms. Vaishnavi Sivakumar, BASLP, MSc. SLP. A Rehabilitation Council of India registered Speech therapist. In this channel you will find Awareness videos related to Speech, language, swallowing and hearing disorders. Bursting myths and facts about Speech and language development and other disorders and disabilities.

Our team is fluent in Tamil, English, Malayalam, Kannada and Hindi.
